system.description:
• Effect: The Parry option within Flourish Manoeuvres now succeeds automatically on a natural 16+ on the Dexterity check, without needing to meet or beat the attack roll.
  • A successful Perfect Parry (not just a normal Parry) triggers a free Riposte immediately — this Riposte does not cost the round's Flourish Manoeuvre, since the parry itself was the reaction spent
